args: Implement docs/plans/bylaw-one-clean-ui-plan.md: open one draft PR with the preview URL at the top; rename the site to Bylaw One with the descriptor "Bengaluru's building rules. One code."; apply the dg2n style (tokens, two-part headlines, numbered sections, honest labels, one coral accent never used for text); rebuild the home page with no map and no plot inputs: hero, 01 the problem, 02 a five-step FAR story (2004, 2007, 2017, 2025, today) with verbatim excerpts and page links that pass the fidelity check, 03 the code by subject, 04 recent changes, FAQ and closing line; cut the header to The code, What changed and About with everything else in the footer; make subject pages open with what applies today as clean tables with units and conditions in words, older and related rules collapsed; clean document pages with details on tap and only relevant gap notices; newest first on What changed and Sources; remove plot features from view while keeping the resolver in the repository; add plausibility bounds, the hectare fix and reclassification of non-FAR rows so no implausible value is displayed; design for phones first; keep accessibility, page budgets, language and browser checks in CI; commit and push as you go, keep docs/progress.md current and the PR's "For owner review", "Decisions made" and "Known gaps" sections up to date; never invent or rewrite legal text.
